full_judgment: 28. It is well settled that when it is established that the husband and wife were residing in the same house at the relevant time, the husband, is duty bound to explain the circumstances how his wife met her death and in the absence of any explanation coming from the husband irresistible presumption is that it is the husband who is responsible for her death. With this regard reliance can be placed in the case of State vs Aynul Huq reported in 9 MLR 393. This view also receives support in the case of Gouranga Kumar Saha vs State reported in 2 BLC (AD) 126, Abdul Motaleb Howlader vs State reported in 5 MLR (AD) 362, State vs Md Shafiqul Islam reported in 43 DLR (AD) 92, State vs Kadam Ali Mondal reported in 1990 BLD (AD) 228, Dipok Kumar Sarker vs State reported in 40 DLR(AD) 139, State vs Kalu Bepari reported in 43 DLR 249 and Samsuddin vs State reported in 45 DLR 587.
